name: What permits are required for a kitchen expansion in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a kitchen expansion in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen expansion in the Bay Area typically requires multiple permits, including structural, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits. Depending on the scope, you might also need planning permits, particularly if the expansion alters the exterior footprint or involves zoning changes. Local jurisdictions like Pacifica or Millbrae have specific requirements and review processes. A qualified general contractor will handle permit applications, plans, and inspections, ensuring all work complies with local building codes and regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen expansions require structural, electrical, plumbing, and sometimes planning permits in Bay Area cities, which a general contractor typically manages.
